transcript.content: Hello, welcome in—thanks for coming today. Can you tell me what brings you in to see me?

Um... well. I'm just having some trouble at work, I guess. Customers will ask me a simple question... like when a ring repair will be ready. And my answer just... it goes all over the place. I'll start talking about the invoices, and then... somehow I'm on about garden soil, or the mortgage papers. I can just see them losing me. So... that's why I came in.
Over the past couple of weeks, have you noticed yourself feeling unusually energetic, elated, or needing much less sleep than normal?
No... no, not really. I don't think so. I've just been... normal, I guess. Not extra energetic or anything.
Have you noticed or experienced anything unusual lately, like hearing voices or sounds that others don't seem to hear, or having thoughts or beliefs that others find strange or hard to believe?

Um... well. I mean, sometimes when the shop is quiet... I've thought I heard something. Just... a woman, muttering my name. Coming from the polishing room. And... sometimes I smell burning metal. Even when I know all the torches are off. It just... it feels real enough that I usually go back there to check. But... I don't know. Maybe it's just the building.
How long have you been noticing these experiences—like the muttering voice, the burning smell, and the trouble keeping your thoughts on track—has this been going on for days, weeks, or longer?

Um... longer than a few weeks. I guess... it's been a while. Maybe around a year and eight months ago? That's when I first noticed the... the muttering, and the smells. And... I don't know, just worrying that the customers were watching us. But yeah... about that long.
Have you had any recent head injuries, seizures, or been diagnosed with any medical conditions—or used any drugs or alcohol—around the time these symptoms started?
No. Nothing like that. I don't drink, and... no injuries. Just... no.
Have you noticed any changes in your memory or ability to concentrate—like forgetting things more often or feeling confused—since these experiences started?
Um... no, not really. I mean... my memory is fine, I think. I just... I just go to work and come home. I haven't noticed any... confusion. Just what I said before.
Over this past year and a half, have you noticed these experiences affecting your ability to do your job well, keep up with friends or family, or take care of yourself day-to-day?

Um... well, it's... it's been harder at work. I've been doing less custom jewelry work lately. I just... I keep missing deadlines for repairs. And when I'm talking to clients about what they want, I kind of... lose track of what we're saying. My husband has to double-check all the invoices now. I used to do that all myself, but... yeah. It's just harder.
